note: Content contract for the private Control Hub. Today the page is generated in Claude Design from this file — there is no build script in this repo. Phase 5's design lock replaces that with a renderer reading data/state/ at runtime. The weekly-exercise content that used to live here as a 'Backlog' tab now has its own page, Practice.json — the old name read as a to-do list of my own work rather than exercises derived from the brief. metrics[].kind 'guardrail' tints the card; actions[].gate 'human' adds the Approve / Reject / Ask row; questions[].feeds names the label the answer becomes. `lastUpdated` is the date this content last changed. It is provenance for whoever reads this file; the generated pages do NOT render it yet — that lands with the Phase 5 design lock.
